lead.headline: TESLA DEPLOYS FLORIDA ROBOTAXIS AMID MIXED QUARTERLY EARNINGS REPORT
lead.summary: The electric vehicle pioneer has officially expanded its driverless robotaxi service to Orlando and Tampa, hot on the heels of its Miami launch. While the technological roll-out marches forward, the company's financial books tell a more complicated tale of high costs. Investors are keeping a watchful eye as the firm bets its bottom dollar on an autonomous future.

stories.headline: WAYMO TO SPLIT WITH UBER IN KEY CITIES
stories.summary: The Alphabet-owned autonomous vehicle unit has notified ride-hailing giant Uber of plans to end their exclusive partnership in Austin and Atlanta. Waymo plans to launch its own independent app in those markets by January 2028.

stories.headline: WAYMO DRIVERLESS TAXIS BEAT HUMAN SAFETY RECORDS
stories.summary: A new study by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety reveals autonomous electric taxis crash 68 percent less than the average human driver. Though caveats exist in the data, the safety margins represent a major milestone for driverless tech.

stories.headline: MOBILEYE FOUNDER AMNON SHASHUA STEPS DOWN AS CEO
stories.summary: The chief executive of driver-assistance systems supplier Mobileye is relinquishing his post after a highly volatile run. Shashua famously guided the firm through a massive fifteen-billion-dollar sale to Intel and back to the public market.

stories.headline: ELON MUSK NET WORTH PLUNGES SIX HUNDRED BILLION
stories.summary: A brutal five-week market slide has erased a staggering fortune from the world's richest man. Sharp declines in both Tesla and SpaceX share prices drove the massive financial evaporation.

stories.headline: CATHIE WOOD BACKS TESLA AND SPACEX AS TOP PICKS
stories.summary: ARK Invest's leading lady has doubled down on her favorite tech plays, deploying over five hundred and eighty million dollars. Wood named the Elon Musk-led giants as her absolute premier choices for artificial intelligence stock.

lead.headline: MICROSOFT'S COLOSSAL AI BET: THE HERO'S NORTH STAR OR NOOSE?
lead.summary: Tech giant Microsoft is facing intense scrutiny over its aggressive, multi-billion-dollar gamble on artificial intelligence. While CEO Satya Nadella was hailed as a savior after early partnerships with OpenAI, critics now wonder if the massive infrastructure costs will strangle the company's bottom line. The industry is watching closely as the software kingpin fights to maintain its leading edge.

stories.headline: CLAUDE OPUS FIVE CHALLENGES CHATGPT IN BENCHMARK DUEL
stories.summary: Anthropic has unleashed its latest model, Claude Opus 5, boasting impressive scores on frontier benchmarks. The new release aims to squeeze competitors by offering superior performance paired with aggressive cost efficiency.

stories.headline: DEEPSEEK PAUSES FUNDRAISING ROUND AFTER VIRAL LEAKS
stories.summary: Chinese artificial intelligence startup DeepSeek has frozen its latest funding efforts. The sudden halt follows private, controversial investor remarks by founder Liang Wenfeng that leaked onto social media.

stories.headline: YOUTUBE CRACKS DOWN ON LOW QUALITY AI SLOP
stories.summary: The video platform is squeezing the purse strings on channels relying on mass-produced, low-quality artificial intelligence content. New monetization rules aim to protect advertiser trust and champion original human creativity.

stories.headline: AI LOBBYISTS SPEND SIXTY-FIVE MILLION ON MIDTERMS
stories.summary: The artificial intelligence industry is pouring unprecedented cash into the upcoming midterm elections. Power players hope to swing legislative influence and shape future regulations before they get penned into law.

stories.headline: GENERATIVE AI PATENTS TRIPLE IN TWO YEARS
stories.summary: A fresh report from the World Intellectual Property Organization shows a massive surge in generative artificial intelligence patent filings. Experts warn the intellectual property land grab could stifle smaller, decentralized projects.

stories.headline: AI SLEEP TEST SPOTS ALZHEIMER'S IN EARLY STAGES
stories.summary: Researchers have designed a clever artificial intelligence tool that analyzes brain activity during sleep to detect early signs of Alzheimer's. The non-invasive method offers hope for simpler, pre-symptomatic diagnosis.
